settings.heading: Shipping & Delivery
settings.content:
India: free delivery on prepaid orders, usually in 3–7 days.
International: we ship worldwide, including the USA, UK, Canada and Australia. Charges depend on the destination and are shown at checkout.

settings.content:
Pay online: UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), debit or credit cards and netbanking on a secure, encrypted checkout. Your order is confirmed instantly.

Cash on Delivery: available for orders within India.

settings.content: Bulk, export and custom designs available for retailers, restaurants and businesses. Email novacresttrading@gmail.com or see our Wholesale & Export page.
